subject: Post-discovery: architectural deep-dive slot coordination for Starlane
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@starlane.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@starlane.io
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery next steps - deep-dive request

Jonas,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — we got a lot out of it. Team at Starlane (Samir and I) would like to schedule a technical deep-dive to validate the proposed topology and latency targets before we move to procurement.

High-level asks for the session:
- Validate multi-region topology and traffic routing (we run primarily us-west + eu-west)
- Discuss egress/data residency and encryption in flight/at rest
- Walk through KV cache warm-up strategies and expected cold-start behavior
- Rough cost/throughput tradeoffs for 8k vs. 16k context length for our LLM workloads

We can carve out a 60–90m slot. Our timezone is PDT. Samir included a short summary and the environment diagram.

Proposed days: Tue/Wed/Thu next week (Nov 17–19) afternoons PT. Prefer Tue or Thu.

Attachments: starlane-prelim-requirements.pdf, starlane-env-diagram.png

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner
Head of ML Platforms, Starlane
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@starlane.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery next steps - deep-dive request

Alex — great to hear. Happy to run this. Ben (pre-sales infra) and Marissa (solutions eng) will join to cover runtime and cost tradeoffs.

I have the following windows open on Tue/Thu (all PT):
- Tue 11:00–12:30
- Tue 14:00–15:30
- Thu 10:00–11:30
- Thu 15:00–16:30

If any of those work for you, pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite. To help us prepare, can you attach a short Prometheus/data plane metrics sample and confirm whether your traffic goes through a shared NAT (we ask because of egress IP allowlisting)?

I attached a preliminary agenda and example runbook we use for these sessions. If you want the deep-dive to skew more architecture (topology + routing) vs. performance (latency/cost) let me know and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-prelim-agenda.pdf
From: Alex Turner <alex@starlane.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@starlane.io
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery next steps - deep-dive request

Thanks Jonas — Thu 15:00–16:30 PT works best for us. Please book for 90 minutes.

We attached the small Prometheus scrape sample and a short note about our NAT/eip configuration (we use a central NAT gateway in us-west; eu traffic egresses from a managed partner). Also adding a couple of quick asks to the agenda:
- Can Redwood's routing policy be constrained per-customer to prefer regional pools?
- Any limits on model KV cache sharing across tenants?

Attachments: prometheus-sample.yml, starlane-env-diagram.png (resubmitted)

Alex

Alex — thanks for confirming Thursday 15:00 PT. I’ll bring the performance playbook and a short slide on KV cache isolation vs shared warming approaches. A couple items that will make the session high-value if you can share beforehand:
- Typical concurrent requests per minute and P95 token latency target
- Whether you plan to use dedicated pools (reserved) or hosted for initial rollout
- Any compliance constraints we should avoid surfacing in a demo (e.g., no external cloud storage for logs)

Attaching a sample runbook snippet to show the prep we do for similar customers.

See you Thu — Ben
Ben Carter

1) Introductions & outcomes (5m)
2) Topology & regional routing policies (20m) — Marissa
3) Runtime behavior, KV cache strategies, cold-start mitigation (25m) — Ben

5) Q&A and next steps (25m)

Prep notes we’ll cover: egress IP allowlist, KMS/HSM options, recommended quantization for cost/throughput, and an example rollout for a canary to Dedicated pools. Please add any filesystem/credentials details to the shared Drive link below if you want us to run a short live test: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1StarlanePrep

If anything changes or you need to shorten to 60m, flag it here and we’ll tighten the agenda. Looking forward to it.

—Jonas
